title: Joe Rogan Experience #1191 - Peter Boghossian & James Lindsay
summary: Joe Rogan interviews Peter Boghossian and James Lindsay, who describe their hoax papers submitted to academic journals in grievance studies. The conversation runs about two hours and covers academic publishing, ideology and victimhood culture.
why: HN commenters recommend it as an entertaining account of how easily fake papers get published and of problems in academic peer review.

quote.text: If you have not watched Peter Boghossian and James Lindsay on the Joe Rogan show you should.
